verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Mastra memory stores and recalls message history. It also shows that generic processors can 'transform, validate, or control messages'. Nothing documents trimming, summarizing, or filtering history to stay within a context window. Processors are a general building block rather than the documented capability itself, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trim, summarize, or filter conversation history to keep an agent inside its context window
